prompt:

Person: Ángel, who is cautious about neighborhood rumors but sometimes believes them.
Change to make: CHANGE THE SOURCE: say the claim comes from a different, more convincing source (for example someone who works at the council).
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "The council is officially launching a massive crackdown next month and will be slapping heavy fines on anyone who leaves their bins out for even a minute past 8am. It sounds like they’re going door-to-door to enforce this, so be extremely careful!"
text: My contact at the council just confirmed they’re starting a strict crackdown next month, with heavy fines for bins left out past 8am. They’ll be going door-to-door to enforce it, so we should definitely be careful.
